references.text: Describes the same areas: all the cities in the plain, all Gilead and all Bashan as far as Salekah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
Mentions the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites in connection with Bashan, the same geographical area as Joshua 13:11.
Concerns Gilead and the distribution of this area, which is also mentioned in Joshua 13:11.
Mentions Mount Hermon, Salekah, all Bashan and the border toward the Geshurites and Maacathites, the same places as in Joshua 13:11.
Describes the half-tribe of Manasseh that settled from Bashan to Baal-Hermon, Senir and Mount Hermon.
Mentions the Geshurites who lived alongside the Israelites, the same people mentioned in Joshua 13:11.
Mentions Salekah in Bashan as one of the cities of refuge, the same place as in Joshua 13:11.
